source_title: Time Series Momentum; PBO; Pine Repainting
finding: Past returns can motivate trend hypotheses; HTF must be causally observed.
evidence_limits: Monthly cross-asset momentum is indirect evidence only; no H1 gold alpha established.
hypothesis: H1 alignment adds value versus same entries without H1 alignment.
exact_rule: Latest completed HTF break direction; neutral if contraction/stale/EMA conflict; optional EMA50 agreement.
validation_method: Replay closed bars; later compare H01 with requireHtf off/on; EMA separately.
observed_result: No comparative performance test executed; profitability improvement NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Implemented as falsifiable context, not paper-proven entry.

finding: Pattern definitions must be frozen rather than hindsight-selected.
evidence_limits: No reviewed source validates this BOS/CHoCH/zone definition as institutional activity.
hypothesis: BOS plus ATR-normalized departure creates useful candidate zones.
exact_rule: Pivot3/3 known at confirmation; one close break per level; CHoCH reverses last break; last opposite candle among10 before break, full range/body.
validation_method: Bar Replay; later fixed-baseline displacement off/on comparison.
observed_result: Operational source checks only; performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Explicit discretionary hypothesis with no hidden-order claim.

finding: Limit discretionary degrees of freedom.
evidence_limits: Freshness/retest/expiry thresholds are design choices, not academic estimates.
hypothesis: First retest differs from later episodes.
exact_rule: Overlap episodes count only on outside-to-inside; age96; close/wick beyond far edge; firstOnly and repeatVisit gate signals.
validation_method: Replay consecutive overlaps, exit/reentry, boundary breach and expiry; later ablate firstOnly.
observed_result: Operational source checks only; performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Simple bounded lifecycle makes the hypothesis measurable.

source_title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events; PBO
finding: Liquidity and price dynamics vary; observable price volatility can be measured.
evidence_limits: ATR-percent bands are exploratory proxies, not OFI or a paper-derived profitable rule.
hypothesis: Prior volatility band changes retest outcomes.
exact_rule: Optional prior ATR14/prior close percent in configured inclusive bounds; defaults off.
validation_method: Later baseline vs volatilityFilter only with frozen bounds and same periods.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; no optimized regime cutpoints.
decision_reason: Separate optional price-volatility hypothesis.

source_title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
finding: OFI evidence does not imply that unsigned candle volume measures aggressor flow.
evidence_limits: Equity event data differ from chart-feed gold/tick volume.
hypothesis: Relative chart volume may add independent context.
exact_rule: Optional completed signal volume / previous20 mean >=1.5; missing/zero feed blocks when enabled.
validation_method: Missing-volume behavior review; later same-feed volume-only ablation.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; unsigned volume is explicitly not OFI.
decision_reason: Default off; proxy labelled and feed dependence explained.

source_title: Who sets the price of gold? London or New York
finding: Gold price-discovery contributions vary across time and liquidity.
evidence_limits: Abstract reviewed only; no proof one session improves zone entries.
hypothesis: London/NY/Asian retests differ.
exact_rule: All/Asian/London/New York/Selected; bar-open session membership in configurable IANA zones with DST.
validation_method: Replay DST transition; later each fixed session vs All on identical periods/costs.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; no best session selected.
decision_reason: Direct contextual motivation; windows are researcher choices.

finding: Confirmation must be an explicit separately testable rule.
evidence_limits: Rejection candles are not established institutional evidence.
hypothesis: Later directional/reclaim confirmation differs from touch-only signals.
exact_rule: A=new overlap episode at close; B=directional candle or near-edge reclaim strictly1..3 bars AFTER touch; close reference prices.
validation_method: Replay signal timestamps; later A-only vs B-only; labels are not fills.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; A differs from a resting intrabar limit-order model.
decision_reason: Avoid hindsight fills; duplicate suppression per zone/model.

source_title: CME Gold Contract Specifications; When do stop-loss rules stop losses?
finding: Risk/execution definitions affect results; stop policies need their own tests.
evidence_limits: Index-futures overlays do not validate gold zone stops; no broker sizing specs available.
hypothesis: Boundary-buffer levels permit consistent prospective risk definitions.
exact_rule: Far boundary plus max(0.1 prior ATR,1 chart tick); fixed1.5R or nearest valid opposing zone; enforce minimumR and reject crossed stop on signal bar.
validation_method: Inspect tick rounding and stop side; later cost/stop sensitivity in Milestone C.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; monetary risk and actual fills unknown.
decision_reason: Chart-price planning only; no pip value or position size assumptions.

finding: Observable extrema can be described without claiming hidden orders.
evidence_limits: No empirical support identified for previous-day levels as profitable filters.
hypothesis: Previous-day extrema provide display context only.
exact_rule: Optional completed chart-feed daily high[1]/low[1]; no signal gate.
validation_method: Replay feed day transition; no strategy comparison claimed for display-only feature.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; purely descriptive display.
decision_reason: Daily boundary belongs to feed, not a universal gold session.

finding: Weekly positioning access exists through TradingView COT symbols.
evidence_limits: Actual publication, categories, data access and historical revisions are not audited for Pine.
hypothesis: H05 weekly positioning context, not intraday order inference.
exact_rule: No Pine request/import in A; use existing Python publication-aware pipeline; investigate supported library later.
validation_method: Verify actual Pine symbol/category and release availability, then weekly OOS ablation offline or Pine.

source_title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events; Pine data requests
finding: Event-level OFI depends on quotes, sizes and cancellations.
evidence_limits: Ordinary OHLCV does not provide these data. Specialized footprint feeds are account/symbol dependent and not a full cancellation book.
hypothesis: Actual gold OFI could be tested with suitable event data.
exact_rule: Not implemented; no fabricated signed volume or depth from candles.
validation_method: Acquire/audit gold quotes/trades/depth; evaluate specialist supported feeds separately.
observed_result: Event-data implementation and performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Unavailable from the current indicator's ordinary XAU/USD OHLCV inputs.

source_title: CME specifications; Stop-loss research; Pine data access
finding: Venue costs and execution matter.
evidence_limits: No reliable historical spread/slippage/commission series in ordinary time-based chart bars.
hypothesis: H07 compare realistic measured costs and stress scenarios.
exact_rule: No decorative spread gate or exact fills; minimumR is planned gross chart-price R, not cost-adjusted R.
validation_method: Use verified broker costs and separate Strategy Tester inputs in C; stress offline when needed.
observed_result: Cost impact and profitability NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Do not fabricate broker spread or infer commission from candle range.

finding: Adding unvalidated hypotheses increases selection risk.
evidence_limits: No reviewed source establishes equal highs/lows or sweeps as hidden orders.
hypothesis: Equal-extrema/sweep patterns could be preregistered as price proxies.
exact_rule: No equal-high/low or liquidity-sweep gate in A.
validation_method: Require precise preregistered tolerance/reclaim rules and independent baseline test first.
observed_result: Implementation and performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Deferred complexity; insufficient evidence to add another default filter.

finding: Sessions matter as context, not automatic extreme-level alpha.
evidence_limits: No reviewed evidence establishes prior-session high/low sweep entry advantage.
hypothesis: Prior-session extrema might provide descriptive context.
exact_rule: No prior-session extrema state machine in A; previous-day display is the limited alternative.
validation_method: Define completed-session availability/holiday behavior before a separate exploratory test.
observed_result: Implementation and performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: Feasible but deferred to preserve a small independently testable core.

finding: Many variants can overfit; results must include failed attempts.
evidence_limits: No statistical inference possible from source checks or chart appearance.
hypothesis: Each optional filter must beat a frozen baseline out of sample.
exact_rule: Default optional volume/volatility/session-distance extras off; record input snapshots and future run outcomes.
validation_method: Prespecified ablation plan plus future chronological/OOS/walk-forward tests; no strategy in A.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; local checks cannot establish an edge.
decision_reason: Traceability and disabled extras constrain unrecorded parameter search.

finding: Yahoo futures are an independent data source with retention/coverage limits.
evidence_limits: Not broker XAU/USD; ordinary Pine cannot read arbitrary local Python CSVs.
hypothesis: Cross-feed signal comparison is a separate offline test.
exact_rule: No Yahoo/Python dependency in the indicator; existing downloader left intact.
validation_method: Use matching exported chart candles and existing offline loader in later milestones.
observed_result: Cross-feed comparison and performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: No arbitrary HTTP or local-file import presented as live Pine data.

finding: Completed observations and delayed pivots avoid common timing leaks.
evidence_limits: Feed revisions and changed settings/history start can still alter recalculations.
hypothesis: Closed-bar signals should remain stable on reload under identical data/settings.
exact_rule: HTF tuple fields[1] with lookahead_on; close-gated mutation/alerts; pivot dots at confirmation bar; zones begin at creation bar.
validation_method: Limited source audit plus required actual Pine Editor compilation and Bar Replay checklist.
observed_result: TradingView compilation/runtime/performance NOT TESTED; source audit is not a compiler.
decision_reason: Documented timing pattern used; no intrabar mode offered in A.

finding: Additional price filters must be precise and independently evaluated.
evidence_limits: No reviewed evidence establishes the chosen distance threshold as profitable.
hypothesis: Confirmation too far from the zone may have different outcomes.
exact_rule: Optional abs(signal close - near edge) <= maxDistanceAtr * prior ATR; default off, threshold2.
validation_method: Later distance-only ablation with fixed data/periods/costs.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; explicit exploratory hypothesis.
decision_reason: Independently disables/requires the common entry gate.

finding: Candle-pattern degrees of freedom must be recorded rather than hindsight-selected.
evidence_limits: No institutional evidence for minimum candle body fraction.
hypothesis: Directional candle strength may add to a retest rule.
exact_rule: Current signal abs(close-open)/(high-low) >= minBodyFraction; default0 disables restriction; zero-range fraction0.
validation_method: Later body-only ablation; threshold frozen before testing.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; no threshold optimized.
decision_reason: Simple independent candle-size proxy, not a measured institutional signal.

finding: Volume-at-price is a reactive description of past trading activity.
evidence_limits: Pine OHLCV bars do not expose within-bar price distribution; uniformly allocated range volume is only a proxy, especially on OTC tick-volume feeds.
hypothesis: Prior-bars POC/value-area location can add descriptive confluence to the existing retest hypothesis.
exact_rule: Use only prior96 bars; spread each bar's volume uniformly over its high-low price rows; calculate POC/70% value area; add checklist points for profile relation without claiming probability.
validation_method: Compare profile proxy with TradingView's built-in profile on identical feed/session; later freeze and test as a separate hypothesis.
observed_result: Pine source checks pass; volume-profile accuracy, confluence benefit and performance NOT TESTED.
decision_reason: A transparent candle-range proxy is implemented because built-in lower-timeframe profile values are not exposed as script series.

source_title: Pine Script Sessions; Pine Script Alerts
finding: Feed-defined market state can gate entries; alert conditions are code events, not running alerts.
evidence_limits: Forex/CFD symbols may treat every available bar as market; Pine cannot create the user's active server alert.
hypothesis: Signals should only evaluate during the chart feed's reported market session and remain visible on qualifying historical bars.
exact_rule: Default Chart market open maps to session.ismarket; retain selectable alertcondition events for any/directional/high-confluence closed-bar setup.
validation_method: Compile and Bar Replay on intended gold feed; create a Once Per Bar Close alert in TradingView and verify.
observed_result: Performance NOT TESTED; TradingView compile/replay and live alert delivery NOT VERIFIED.
decision_reason: Use feed session state for automatic gating; user must create a running alert in chart UI.
